==Seamus==
Um, I've never done this before, but I figured people should know.  Most of the images on this page don't really appear to be from the comic.  While a few are from the comic series, the rest are copyright to someone named Seamus Gallagher. This is the blog where he posts most of his work, but he has also posted on dragonmount etc etc.....

[http://seamassketches.blogspot.com/]

Just scroll down, and on the right hand side of the page there will be a link to his wheel of time posts, or you could click on this one

[http://seamassketches.blogspot.com/search/label/wheel%20of%20time]

If I'm wrong I'm wrong, but if not maybe there should be a page put up about Seamus Gallagher.
